heading: Today
text: Some patchy fog early.  Sun mixing with periods of clouds, more numerous south.  Seasonably warm.  Highs 80 to 85.  Winds light, tending to becoming south near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy. Patches of river valley fog. Warm and increasingly humid. Lows in the 60s, closer to 70 in the Champlain Valley, near 60 in the cool spots northeast.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly to mostly sunny.  More afternoon clouds with a good chance of scattered afternoon showers or a thunderstorm in NY, and a rising chance late in VT and the Berkshires.  Warm and humid.  Highs ranging through the 80s.  Light winds, tending to becoming south to southwest near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.
